response.overview: The party was amazing, and you had great fun, but you're still in the mood to do something. Luckily, the girl you met while partying, the gorgeous Nikky Dandelion, feels the same way, so she invites you to an intimate afterparty. Sounds tempting, and you're not one to spoil a good thing, right.
response.title: Seduced by Nikky Dandelion
